name: @pipeworx/mcp-ny-procurement

tools.name: ny_procurement_awards
tools.description: Search NEW YORK STATE government contract awards & procurement from the official Procurement Report for State Authorities on data.ny.gov (the §2800 Public Authorities Law filings collected by the NY Authorities Budget Office). Each result is a procurement contract awarded by a New York State authority (the awarding agency) with the winning vendor, the contract dollar amount, the procurement type, the award/solicitation process, the description of goods/services, and award/begin dates. Filter by vendor, awarding agency/authority, keyword, procurement type, fiscal year, and/or a minimum amount; results are ranked by contract amount (biggest awards first) by default. Use this for questions like "who won the biggest New York State contracts", "top vendors to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority", or "NY state software contracts". This is NEW YORK STATE data (not federal, not New York City).

vendor.description: Winning vendor name to match (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "IBM", "Turner Construction".

agency.description: Awarding NY State authority / agency name (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "Metropolitan Transportation Authority", "Power Authority", "Dormitory Authority".

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the procurement description, e.g. "software", "construction", "consulting".

procurement_type.description: Procurement type substring, e.g. "Technology - Software", "Construction", "Consulting Services", "Commodities/Supplies".

fiscal_year.description: Reporting fiscal year (calendar year of the fiscal-year-end date), e.g. 2022. Matches contracts whose fiscal_year_end_date falls in that year.

min_amount.description: Only return awards whose contract amount is at least this many dollars, e.g. 1000000.

sort.description: Sort order: "amount" = largest contract first (default), "date" = most recent award date first.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: ny_procurement_vendor
tools.description: Aggregate a vendor's NEW YORK STATE contract awards from the Procurement Report for State Authorities on data.ny.gov: total dollars awarded, number of contracts, and a breakdown by awarding agency/authority and by fiscal year. Matches the vendor name as a case-insensitive substring, so it also surfaces name variants (e.g. "IBM CORP" vs "IBM LC LODGING"). Use this to size up a single vendor's business with New York State authorities. This is NEW YORK STATE data (not federal, not New York City).

vendor.description: Vendor name to aggregate (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "Deloitte", "IBM".

fiscal_year.description: Optional: restrict to one reporting fiscal year (calendar year of the fiscal-year-end date), e.g. 2022.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ny-procurement forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ny-procurement pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
